Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from the customer. Heads-up: the front desk closes early this Friday afternoon because the office is moving. When it arrived, the base was cracked and the switch worked only some of the time. Your support chat was really helpful, thank you for the quick handling.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Ana
the customer
